Resolves #20646

🌿 An app can no longer set a header border that nothing draws.

`--grid-container-header-cell-border-bottom` came in with #3412 in 2022, and no stylesheet has ever read it: `git log -S` finds neither `var(--grid-container-header-cell-border-bottom` nor an SCSS `v(...)` consumer anywhere in the history. Five themes defined it, and the Workstation bridge and the Header Groups example set it. WorkstationPaletteBridgeNL asserted its inherited value, which passes whether or not anything renders it. The header's bottom border is drawn by `src/grid/header/Toolbar.scss:2` from `--grid-container-border-color`.

This PR deletes the token at all eight sites. The census comment above the spec's composed-value rows now names the gradient, since the border shorthand it described is gone.

Evidence: L2 (compiled-CSS diff across every theme, plus the affected NL spec run locally) → L2 required for AC-1 and AC-2. No residual.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 (`git grep` returns nothing) | `git grep -n -- --grid-container-header-cell-border-bottom` exits 1 at this head. |
| AC-2 (the Workstation spec passes without the row; no visual golden changes) | `WorkstationPaletteBridgeNL.spec.mjs` 4/4 locally. No visual golden can change, shown by construction: I built all five themes in development on `dev` and on this branch with the same `sass`, and `diff -r` of `dist/development/css` (maps excluded) removes exactly the 8 token declarations and adds nothing. |

## Deltas from ticket

None. The example's line from #20638, which the ticket listed as conditional, landed first and is removed here.

- `node ./buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -e dev -t all -f -n` on `dev` 5788bef5e8 and on this branch: the only differing lines are 8 `<   --grid-container-header-cell-border-bottom: …` removals. They come from the five themes, the Workstation `grid-tokens` mixin (included twice) and the example.
- `env -u NEO_MCP_REMOTE_TOKEN NEO_NL_PORT=8291 NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=<brain checkout> npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationPaletteBridgeNL.spec.mjs`: 4 passed, after `npm i` matched the lock (#20642's check).
